novelty: First exact context-local effect coding of the three natural semantic-opener contribution vectors into an arithmetic shared term and zero-sum delimiter contrasts, with interventions defined at the native projected head write.
distinct_from_prior_art: No learned rank, PCA, projector, or reconstruction is used.
R560 swapped one source factor between paired rows but did not construct complete same-context delimiter triplets or separate shared and centered terms.
The OPEN-only confirmation localized source position but did not split the opener term by semantic role.
The zero-removal established necessity and nonselectivity but removed shared support and delimiter contrast together.
operational_identity: mu+delta[c_prime] equals the complete natural donor opener term t[c_prime]; contrast swap must be bitwise/algebraically identical to natural term replacement.
live_selectivity_control: Use centered correct-closer effect versus common three-closer mean effect with target/common ratio >=2; same-state rewrites test invariance rather than a structurally weak fixed absolute bar.
